verdict.rationale: Teller docs confirm webhook events exist for enrollment/data changes (teller-docs-17) and describe how to register a webhook URL (teller-docs-7), covering the general 'push not poll' data-freshness goal. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of webhook payload signing/verification mechanism, nor independent confirmation that webhooks reliably fire for transactions, balances, and connection-state changes as described. Missing for 10: explicit signature/verification scheme for webhooks, documented list of event types (transaction created, balance updated, enrollment disconnected), and third-party/hands-on confirmation of webhook delivery reliability.
